newsitem.title: USA: Hathaway buys Tate unit for $1.332 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hathaway buys Tate unit for $1.332 mln.

text.p: Hathaway Corp said that it bought 100 percent of the outstanding stock of process automation systems supplier Tate Integrated Systems Inc for $1.332 million.

The company said it bought Maryland-based Tate Integrated for $718,000 in cash, $400,000 in a 10 percent note due June 30, 1997 and $214,000 payable when certain of Tate's accounts receivable are collected.
Hathaway bought the shares from Tate Engineering Services Corp, a division of privately-held Tate Industries.
Tate Integrated has developed a software system for supervisory control and data acquisition and distributed control systems which has been installed in more than 30 sites.
Hathaway said the system would be marketed to the power utility industry, in combination with certain existing Hathaway products.
